neighbours.label: Broad unit; best guess: the Unicode ellipsis '…' as a mid-sentence pause, vs the same sentences with commas or full stops
fire: We waited at the gate for an hour… then the bus finally came.
She opened the letter… and started to laugh.
The engine coughed… sputtered… and died on the hill.
I thought about it for a while… maybe next year.
The lights flickered… then the whole street went dark.
He looked at the map… we were completely lost.
The test results came back… all normal, thankfully.
So the plan is simple… we leave at dawn.
